name: TM7 Jasmine Rice – 2 Portions
ingredients: 1 tsp olive oil or butter, optional

steps.text: Rinse 150 g jasmine rice thoroughly under cold water until the water runs almost clear. Put 1000 g water and 1/2 tsp fine salt into the mixing bowl. Put the 150 g rinsed jasmine rice into the simmering basket and insert the basket.
Check the rice. If you prefer it slightly softer, cook for a further 2 min / 100°C / speed 4.
Carefully lift out the simmering basket. Fluff the rice with a fork. Stir through 1 tsp olive oil or butter if using, then leave to stand for 3-5 minutes before serving.
